abstract: PURPOSE: Increased levels of cell-free circulating DNA have been described in various malignancies as a diagnostic and prognostic biomarker. We analyzed the significance of cell-free DNA in patients with testicular cancer. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Cell-free DNA was isolated from the serum of 74 patients with testicular cancer, including 39 with seminoma and 35 with nonseminoma, and 35 healthy individuals. Real-time polymerase chain reaction was used to quantify a 106, a 193 and a 384 actin-beta DNA fragment. DNA integrity is expressed as the ratio of large (193 or 384 bp) to short (106 bp) DNA fragments. RESULTS: Actin-beta-106/193/384 fragment levels were significantly increased in patients with cancer compared to those in healthy individuals (each p <0.001). DNA integrity was significantly decreased in patients with cancer (p <0.001). Cell-free DNA fragment levels were not different when comparing patients with nonseminoma and seminoma (p >0.24). ROC analysis demonstrated that cell-free DNA levels distinguished patients with cancer from healthy individuals with 87% sensitivity and 97% specificity. Even in 31 patients in whom the established serum tumor markers alpha-fetoprotein, human chorionic gonadotropin, placental alkaline phosphatase and lactate dehydrogenase were normal cell-free DNA levels allowed us to distinguish between patients with cancer and healthy individuals with 84% sensitivity and 97% specificity. Cell-free DNA levels were more frequently increased in patients with clinical stage 3 than in patients with stage 1 or 2 disease (p <0.046). CONCLUSIONS: Cell-free DNA levels are increased in patients with testicular cancer and they allow the accurate discrimination of healthy individuals. The high sensitivity of cell-free DNA could facilitate the management of testicular cancer, especially in patients with conventional tumor markers that are not increased.
abstract_ja: 目的：遊離DNA（cfDNA）は、様々な悪性腫瘍において診断・予後のバイオマーカーとして上昇することが報告されている。本研究では精巣がんにおけるcfDNAの意義を検討した。方法：精巣がん患者74例（セミノーマ39例、非セミノーマ35例）と健常者35例の血清から遊離DNAを単離した。リアルタイムPCRにより、106、193、384塩基対のアクチンβDNA断片を定量した。DNAの完全性は、長い断片（193または384 bp）と短い断片（106 bp）の比で表した。結果：アクチンβ断片量は、健常者と比較して癌患者で有意に増加していた（いずれもp<0.001）。DNAの完全性は癌患者で有意に低下していた（p<0.001）。cfDNA量は非セミノーマとセミノーマの間で差がなかった（p>0.24）。ROC解析では、cfDNA量は癌患者と健常者を感度87%、特異度97%で区別した。従来の血清腫瘍マーカーであるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ、乳酸脱水素酵素が正常であった31例においても、cfDNA量は感度84%、特異度97%で患者と健常者を区別できた。cfDNA量は臨床病期III期の患者でI期またはII期よりも高頻度に上昇していた（p<0.046）。結論：精巣がん患者ではcfDNA量が上昇し、健常者を正確に識別できる。cfDNAの高い感度は、従来の腫瘍マーカーが上昇していない患者において精巣がんの管理を支援する可能性がある。
